mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE role = 'user' AND deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{start}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE role = 'assistant' AND deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{start}
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(duration), 0)::float8 FROM operation_log WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'fail') AS failures, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS cost, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS tokens, COALESCE(AVG(duration), 0)::float8 AS avg_duration, COALESCE(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration NULLS LAST), 0)::float8 AS p50_duration, COALESCE(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration NULLS LAST), 0)::float8 AS p95_duration FROM llm_trace WHERE deleted = 0 AND start_time >= #{start}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ttft_calls, COALESCE(AVG(ttft), 0)::float8 AS avg_ttft, COALESCE(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ttft), 0)::float8 AS p95_ttft FROM llm_trace WHERE deleted = 0 AND start_time >= #{start} AND ttft IS NOT NULL

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(model_name, ''), '未知模型') AS model_name, COUNT(*) AS calls, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'fail') AS failures, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS cost, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS tokens, COALESCE(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration NULLS LAST), 0)::float8 AS p95_duration FROM llm_trace WHERE deleted = 0 AND start_time >= #{start} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cost DESC, calls DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT to_char(start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE evaluated) AS scored, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT evaluated) AS pending FROM llm_trace WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'success' AND start_time >= #{start} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT start_time AS start_time, eval_scores AS eval_scores FROM llm_trace WHERE deleted = 0 AND evaluated AND eval_scores IS NOT NULL AND start_time >= #{start} ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
